# Memory and memory import (area `memory`)

What FERB remembers about the owner, how it is recalled within limits, and importing memory from other assistants.

Active decisions here. Run `tools/kb/run kb show <file>` for the ones governing one file, their tests and open work; never reword an owner decision (supersede it).

- **MEM-1** (owner): FERB keeps the owner fact store. Procedure learning is replaced by a short "how I did it" note on each verified episode, retrieved by search for similar requests.
- **MEM-2** (owner): Forgetting a fact deletes the fact, its versions and its watcher-captured sources (trail rows), and blocks it from being re-learned. The owner's chat message that stated it stays: chat history is the owner's own record. FERB's past answers and traces are not scrubbed.
- **MEM-3** (owner): For memory, the owner's pass verdict counts as verified, as the checker's pass does; the owner's fail overrides the checker. The owner's latest verdict decides.
- **MEM-5** (owner): Memory has three tiers. Tier 1, the core profile, is always on in every role's prompt within a hard budget (about 2-3k tokens). Tier 2, the versioned fact store, holds everything. Tier 3 holds verified episodes with their how-notes, and playbooks. Everything outside Tier 1 is retrieved within limits, so prompts don't grow with memory.
- **MEM-6** (owner): Memory retrieval fuses a local embedding model running on the Mac with keyword search (bm25); the same search serves facts, episodes and old chat.
- **MEM-7** (owner): A change to a fact in the profile updates the profile at once, by code, with no model. A weekly model pass (sooner when over budget) compacts it: the model chooses and groups entries, code renders them from the facts, so the owner's words are never paraphrased.
- **MEM-8** (owner): The planner's remember rule and the daily distill's chat pass capture durable facts about the owner said in passing, not only after "remember ...". A fact FERB paraphrases is saved as FERB's understanding (MEM-12).
- **MEM-9** (owner): No special exclusion of health or finance facts in the planner or the distill. Secrets are masked by redaction as always.
- **MEM-10** (owner): Code stores what a remembered quote is about (from the task) next to the owner's exact words, so a line like "ok. score this 1 star - not ordering this again" still makes sense later. The words themselves are never reworded.
- **MEM-11** (owner): Forgetting a person or site also removes it from the known destinations, so a send to it asks again.
- **MEM-12** (owner): FERB saves facts itself, what the owner states and what it works out, each labelled by origin (the owner's words / FERB's understanding / observed). No Keep/Edit/Drop questions: a quiet "Memory: noted ..." line the owner can ignore or correct by talking. Memory never authorizes an action. A memory page in the app shows and edits everything.
- **MEM-13** (owner): From installed apps and their usage FERB works out what the owner mostly does, their most-used apps, main browser and main profile/account in it; it shows that once as "here's what I saw: ..." (no yes/no loop), stores it as observed facts, and refreshes it as usage changes. What holds up is promoted into Tier 1.
- **MEM-14** (owner): FERB's own understanding and observed facts that look over are retired automatically and the owner is told once. The owner's own words are retired automatically only when their recorded end date passes; otherwise FERB tells the owner once "this looks over, I'll stop using it", stops using it, keeps it as history, and restores it when the owner says it still holds.
- **MEM-15** (owner): The owner's own words join Tier 1 at once (same turn). FERB's understanding and observed facts join once they hold up (seen on 2 separate days, or standing 7 days uncorrected), and their join adds one quiet "Now always on: ... (label)" note card with Correct / Forget, never a question. The profile stays within its budget; the weekly pass only chooses and groups. The profile text is identical between turns unless a profile entry changed.
- **MEM-16** (owner): The owner's messages and FERB's short replies are indexed in the same fused search as facts and episodes. The planner gets the few old exchanges matching the current message. chat.history searches by meaning and by date and reads pages from the database instead of loading the whole history.
- **MEM-17** (agent): PROFILE_TOKENS = 2,500 (within MEM-5's about 2-3k), counted as FERB's context counts (4 characters a token). Every render stops at the budget; what is left out is counted in one line and makes the profile pass due.
- **MEM-18** (agent): The owner's words hold up at once. FERB's understanding and observed facts hold up once their sources span two separate days, or once they have stood a full weekly pass (7 days) without being replaced, retired or forgotten. An item the owner kept under an older build's Keep question holds up at once; the old setup dump never does. "Used without correction" (MEM-12) needs exposure records.
- **MEM-20** (agent): The pass runs weekly, or sooner when over budget, at most one try an hour; an owner fact that doesn't fit makes it due early, at most once in 24 h (EARLY_PASS_HOURS). The model returns sections of ids and `ended`; code refuses ids that don't hold up, renders every entry word for word, retires the ended ones ("FERB's weekly check") and tells the owner once in chat.
- **MEM-21** (agent): The planner sees similar existing facts and names any a new fact replaces (`replaces`, ids checked by code); the "Memory: noted" line names what was replaced. A version resting on the owner's words now ends every current version of its fact and the named ids that hold; any other version never ends one the owner stated. Identical words are credited to the existing item (the owner's first), never a twin.
- **MEM-22** (agent): The daily distill stays (one call a day). Its retire on the owner's words (passing `_may_end`) or on its own check is applied and told once, no Retire/Keep question; words older than the item are refused. A stored key is skipped unless the owner's quote replaces it. Items due for a check (`review_at`) are listed to it; one it doesn't retire has its date cleared.
- **MEM-23** (agent): A known destination goes when its stored value is whole words of the forgotten item's content, label or subject name; a host also by its bare host or its site label (4+ letters: "kaggle" for www.kaggle.com); a phone by its digits (6+). The "Forget for good?" list says which.
- **MEM-24** (agent): Code gathers the 25 most-used apps (TOP_APPS), installed/used counts, browsers and Chromium profiles; one model call (mac_profile.md) writes the summary and facts, stored observed and active at once, in Tier 1 only once they hold up. Shown once (setup step, else one chat notice). Re-checked weekly with the profile pass; re-interpreted only when the 10 most-used apps, browsers or profiles changed (facts_fingerprint); a key not given again ends.
- **MEM-25** (agent): The embedding model is minishlab/potion-base-8M (MIT, pinned revision and SHA-256s), a static table (29,528 WordPiece tokens x 256 float32; a text = the normalized mean of its tokens' rows), read by FERB's own tokenizer and memory-mapped safetensors: no numpy, torch, MLX or onnxruntime. Its vocabulary is English-only; other languages and coined words fall back to keywords.
- **MEM-26** (agent): The model files ship in FERB.app (Contents/Resources/models/embeddings/<name>@<rev12>) and are read there, never fetched by the app; a checkout's setup fetches them at install into ~/.ferb/models/embeddings (temporary folder, hashes checked, then renamed); `[memory] embedding_model` can name a folder. Until the model is there, search runs on keywords and recency. Tests never download.
- **MEM-27** (agent): Planner: facts + learned items <= 4,000 tokens and <= 20 items, old chat <= 2,000 tokens and <= 5 exchanges, today's activity <= 2,000 tokens. Worker: 2,000 tokens / 10 items, no pushed chat, activity 2,000. What doesn't fit is one counted line naming memory.read / memory.learned / trail.query. Lookup tools rank at most 100.
- **MEM-28** (agent): A planner turn gets exchanges from any owner chat matching the message (the owner's words + FERB's short reply), never an entry already in its conversation or among this turn's messages, and none in a scheduled run's turn.
- **MEM-29** (agent): Code groups verified cards by goal similarity (PLAYBOOK_SIMILARITY 0.5); one model call says same kind or not and writes the steps; code checks the ids. At most 3 merges an hourly pass, only while no task runs, at most the 6 newest runs per call. A playbook is rewritten as new runs join; the owner's edit is never replaced; a declined group is not asked again.
- **MEM-30** (agent): A card keeps every episode, journal and memory ref, and one ref per distinct origin set of the others; its origin labels are computed from all refs.
- **MEM-31** (agent): A how-note is built from the worker's `how`, the owner's hints to the running task (quoted with their origin, 300 characters each) and the steps the card's recorded tool calls show (at most 12 steps, 600 characters). It is shown for verified runs only.
- **MEM-32** (agent): An owner fact that looks over (MEM-14) is set aside in `memory_set_aside`, beside memory_items: out of prompts, search and the profile at once, kept as history, restored when the owner says the same words again or by memory.restore. The login username it gave stays (it is still theirs and current).
- **MEM-33** (agent): Every turn records the memories it was given (`context.exposure`), so a repeated owner correction ("I told you before") traces to a memory miss and repeat runs show whether a how-note or playbook was used.
- **MEM-34** (agent): memory_items is the source of truth for facts, versioned, with source and validity window. No fact or identity copies live in learning_nodes. Facts tied to a period carry an end date (`until`) or a review date (`review_in_days`).
- **MEM-35** (owner): The owner's own words join Tier 1 at once only when they are about the owner. What the owner says about other things is placed by the weekly profile pass like any other fact.
- **MEM-36** (agent): Code joins the owner's words about the owner (subject "owner") at once, under "Recently said" while it fits, except a fact the owner placed by search (memory.search_only). Code joins FERB's understanding / observed facts about the owner only on an event that shows them holding up (a save on a second day); "standing 7 days" is the weekly pass's to see. The pass places the rest and stays the only scheduled rewrite. The owner's "Always on" pins survive every pass.
